entities.name: Chondeah
entities.description: Young wizard of the Kingdom of Shikar who helped summon a Scarzam Dragon and was hailed a hero.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Swamp King for whom the dragon was to be summoned; destroyed the Kingdom of Khone.

entities.name: Jinno Terimund
entities.description: Chondeah's love, killed by Khonian arrows.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Sorceress of Khone who allied with Chondeah.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Rider of the summoned dragon who attacked Sol'Kanar.

entities.name: Scarzam Dragon
entities.description: Dragon summoned for Sol'Kanar, ridden by Sivitri.

entities.name: Dragon War
entities.description: Conflict in which the dragon was summoned.

events.summary: Jinno Terimund is killed by Khonian arrows after discovering their treacherous plan.
events.quote: who was killed by Khonian arrows

events.summary: Chondeah allies with Gydolien Mor and the dragon is summoned, ridden by Sivitri Scarzam, who attacks Sol'Kanar.
events.quote: the dragon was ridden by none other than Sivitri Scarzam herself

events.summary: Sol'Kanar destroys the Kingdom of Khone, and Chondeah is received as a hero.
events.quote: Sol’Kanar destroyed the Kingdom of Khone

relations.quote: She fell in love with Jinno Terimund
